decisions.reason: As a newly launched aloe vera facial care line with several variants and its own webpage, it fits the firm's core natural-skincare range and shows signs of stronger strategic commitment.

The hyaluronic acid facial serum is close to the firm's established offer and should benefit from demand for simple, effective natural facial care, even if its lower website prominence suggests some portfolio review risk.

The facial cleansing milk complements the firm's existing gentle care positioning, but as a less prominently presented single product at a small firm it is somewhat more exposed to rationalisation than the broader line.
